notes_sk: Spoločná verzia pre OpenPLi a OpenATV. Opravený štart aktualizátora bez modulu dataclasses a pád ECM panela na OpenPLi; rovnaké volania sú opravené aj v informáciách o kanáli a klientoch OSCam. Zahrnuté sú úpravy zoznamov, rozlíšení HD/FHD/WQHD/UHD a kompatibility OpenATV 8.1/GLES. Nastavenia a spravované štartovanie CAM-u zostávajú zachované.
notes_en: Common OpenPLi and OpenATV release. Removes the updater dataclasses dependency and fixes the OpenPLi ECM OSD startup crash, channel information and OSCam client labels. Includes list fitting, HD/FHD/WQHD/UHD layouts and OpenATV 8.1/GLES compatibility. Settings and managed CAM startup are preserved.
authorization: Owner explicitly requested all latest repairs in all our plugins as normal full releases and all required records; this supersedes the earlier publishing pause.
